# I. DATA ACQUISITION AND PREPARATION

## I.1. Initial Data Loading

Loading essential R packages (dplyr, ggplot2, corrplot, etc.) and importing the leaf dataset with proper French encoding. The dataset uses semicolons as separators and commas for decimals, requiring specific import parameters.

```{r}
# Load necessary packages
library(pacman)
p_load(
  dplyr, readr, lubridate, tidyr, stringr, skimr,
  VIM, summarytools, corrplot, janitor, purrr
)

# Set working directory
setwd("C:/Users/U078-N800/Desktop/Ml_Internship/Copy")

# Load the dataset (semicolon as separator and comma for decimal)
leaf_data <- read.csv("BD_Leaf.csv", sep = ";", dec = ",", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE , fileEncoding = "latin1")


# Display basic information about the dataset
cat("Dataset dimensions:", dim(leaf_data), "\n")
cat("Number of rows:", nrow(leaf_data), "\n")
cat("Number of columns:", ncol(leaf_data), "\n")

# Display column names
cat("\nColumn names:\n")
print(colnames(leaf_data))

```

## I.3. Data Type Identification and Conversion

```{r}
# ===============================
cat("2. DATA TYPE IDENTIFICATION AND CONVERSION\n")
cat("==========================================\n")

# Define data types based on domain knowledge
factor_variables <- c(
  "Campagne",           # Campaign
  "Note",              # Note
  "Parc.",             # Parcelle
  "Ferme",             # Farm
  "Variete",           # Variety
  "Cycle",             # Cycle
  "Periode",           # Period
  "Validation_periode", # Period validation
  "Parcelle_de_campagne", # Campaign parcelle
  "Validation_recolte", # Harvest validation
  "Irr.",              # Irrigation type
  "Mois.recolte",      # Harvest month
  "Mois_prelevement"   # Sampling month
)

# Date variables (with their meanings)
date_variables <- c(
  "Impl",              # Date d'implantation (planting date)
  "Prel.",             # Date de prélèvement des samples (sampling date)
  "Date_analyse",      # Analysis date
  "Date_recolte",     # Harvest date
  "Date.commun.récolte"
)

# Numerical variables
numerical_variables <- c(
  "Surf",              # Surface
  "A_ce_jour",         # To this day
  "Tc.Ha_A.1",         # Tc/Ha A-1
  "RH.C_A.1",          # RH%C A-1
  "Age_prel.",         # Age at sampling
  "H2O_feuilles",      # Leaf water content
  "H20_gaines",        # Sheath water content
  "N.",                # Nitrogen %
  "X.P",               # Phosphorus %
  "X.K",               # Potassium %
  "Tc.Ha_A",           # Tc/Ha A
  "RH.C_A",            # RH%C A
  "T_canne_reelle",    # Real cane tons
  "T_pol_canne",       # Pol tons per cane
  "Age.en.Sem.",       # Age in weeks
  "Age.recolte.A",     # Harvest age A
  "Surface.A",         # Surface A
  "Age.des.surf",      # Surface age
  "Num_Ssemaine",      # Week number
  "A.ce.jour"
)

# Check which variables actually exist in the dataset
existing_factors <- intersect(factor_variables, names(leaf_data))
existing_dates <- intersect(date_variables, names(leaf_data))
existing_numerics <- intersect(numerical_variables, names(leaf_data))

cat("FACTOR VARIABLES (", length(existing_factors), " found):\n")
print(existing_factors)
cat("\nDATE VARIABLES (", length(existing_dates), " found):\n")
print(existing_dates)
cat("\nNUMERICAL VARIABLES (", length(existing_numerics), " found):\n")
print(existing_numerics)

# Variables not classified
all_classified <- c(existing_factors, existing_dates, existing_numerics)
unclassified <- setdiff(names(leaf_data), all_classified)
if(length(unclassified) > 0) {
  cat("\nUNCLASSIFIED VARIABLES:\n")
  print(unclassified)
  
  # Suggest classification for unclassified variables based on their content
  cat("\nSUGGESTED CLASSIFICATION FOR UNCLASSIFIED VARIABLES:\n")
  for(var in unclassified) {
    sample_values <- head(unique(leaf_data[[var]][!is.na(leaf_data[[var]]) & leaf_data[[var]] != ""]), 5)
    cat("Variable:", var, "| Sample values:", paste(sample_values, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    
    # Try to guess the type
    non_empty <- leaf_data[[var]][!is.na(leaf_data[[var]]) & leaf_data[[var]] != ""]
    if(length(non_empty) > 0) {
      # Check if it looks numeric (allowing for comma as decimal separator)
      numeric_test <- gsub(",", ".", non_empty)
      if(all(str_detect(numeric_test, "^-?[0-9]*\\.?[0-9]+$|^$"), na.rm = TRUE)) {
        cat("  -> Suggested: NUMERIC\n")
      } else if(length(unique(non_empty)) < 20 && length(non_empty) > 10) {
        cat("  -> Suggested: FACTOR\n")
      } else {
        cat("  -> Suggested: CHARACTER/OTHER\n")
      }
    }
  }
}

# ===============================
# 3. CONVERT DATA TYPES
# ===============================
cat("\n3. DATA TYPE CONVERSION\n")
cat("=======================\n")

# Create a copy for conversion
leaf_data_converted <- leaf_data

# Convert factors
for(var in existing_factors) {
  if(var %in% names(leaf_data_converted)) {
    leaf_data_converted[[var]] <- as.factor(leaf_data_converted[[var]])
    cat("Converted", var, "to factor -", nlevels(leaf_data_converted[[var]]), "levels\n")
  }
}

# Convert dates (handle different date formats)
for(var in existing_dates) {
  if(var %in% names(leaf_data_converted)) {
    # Try different date formats
    original_values <- leaf_data_converted[[var]]
    
    # Check for Excel numeric dates first (like 40542)
    if(all(str_detect(original_values[!is.na(original_values) & original_values != ""], "^[0-9]+$"), na.rm = TRUE)) {
      # Excel date format (days since 1900-01-01, but Excel incorrectly treats 1900 as leap year)
      leaf_data_converted[[var]] <- as.Date(as.numeric(original_values), origin = "1899-12-30")
      cat("Converted", var, "from Excel numeric format to Date\n")
    } else {
      # Try different date formats
      date_converted <- as.Date(original_values, format = "%d/%m/%Y")
      if(all(is.na(date_converted))) {
        date_converted <- as.Date(original_values, format = "%Y-%m-%d")
      }
      if(all(is.na(date_converted))) {
        date_converted <- as.Date(original_values, format = "%m/%d/%Y")
      }
      
      leaf_data_converted[[var]] <- date_converted
      cat("Converted", var, "to Date format\n")
    }
    
    # Show date range
    valid_dates <- leaf_data_converted[[var]][!is.na(leaf_data_converted[[var]])]
    if(length(valid_dates) > 0) {
      date_range <- range(valid_dates)
      cat("  Date range:", as.character(date_range[1]), "to", as.character(date_range[2]), "\n")
    }
  }
}

# Convert numerics (handle comma decimal separator)
for(var in existing_numerics) {
  if(var %in% names(leaf_data_converted)) {
    # Replace empty strings and spaces with NA first
    leaf_data_converted[[var]][leaf_data_converted[[var]] == "" | leaf_data_converted[[var]] == " "] <- NA
    
    # If it's character type, it might have comma decimals - convert them to dots
    if(is.character(leaf_data_converted[[var]])) {
      leaf_data_converted[[var]] <- gsub(",", ".", leaf_data_converted[[var]])
    }
    
    # Store original NA count
    original_nas <- sum(is.na(leaf_data[[var]]))
    
    # Convert to numeric
    leaf_data_converted[[var]] <- as.numeric(leaf_data_converted[[var]])
    
    # Check conversion success
    new_nas <- sum(is.na(leaf_data_converted[[var]]))
    conversion_nas <- new_nas - original_nas
    
    if(conversion_nas > 0) {
      cat("WARNING:", conversion_nas, "values became NA during conversion of", var, "\n")
      # Show some examples of problematic values
      original_values <- leaf_data[[var]]
      problematic <- original_values[is.na(leaf_data_converted[[var]]) & !is.na(original_values)]
      if(length(problematic) > 0) {
        cat("  Examples of unconverted values:", paste(head(problematic, 3), collapse = ", "), "\n")
      }
    } else {
      cat("Successfully converted", var, "to numeric\n")
    }
  }
}


str(leaf_data_converted)
```

## I.4. Campaign Analysis

```{r}
# ===============================
# 3. CAMPAIGN ANALYSIS
# ===============================

leaf_data_converted <- leaf_data_converted %>%
  mutate(Campagne = as.character(Campagne))
cat("3. CAMPAIGN ANALYSIS\n")
cat("====================\n")
campaign_summary <- leaf_data_converted %>%
  group_by(Campagne) %>%
  summarise(
    n_observations = n(),
    n_parcelles = n_distinct(Parc.),
    n_fermes = n_distinct(Ferme),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(Campagne)

print("Observations per Campaign:")
print(campaign_summary)
cat("\nCampaign period coverage:")
cat("From", min(leaf_data_converted$Campagne, na.rm = TRUE), "to", max(leaf_data_converted$Campagne, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Total campaigns:", n_distinct(leaf_data_converted$Campagne, na.rm = TRUE), "\n\n")

# ===============================
# 4. FARM AND PARCELLE STRUCTURE ANALYSIS
# ===============================
cat("4. FARM AND PARCELLE STRUCTURE ANALYSIS\n")
cat("========================================\n")

# Parcelles per farm
parcelle_per_farm <- leaf_data_converted %>%
  group_by(Ferme) %>%
  summarise(
    n_parcelles = n_distinct(Parc.),
    campaigns = paste(sort(unique(Campagne)), collapse = ", "),
    varieties = n_distinct(Variete, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_parcelles))

print("Parcelles per Farm:")
print(parcelle_per_farm)

# Farm consistency across campaigns
farm_campaign <- leaf_data_converted %>%
  group_by(Campagne) %>%
  summarise(
    farms = list(sort(unique(Ferme))),
    n_farms = n_distinct(Ferme),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

print("\nFarms per Campaign:")
print(farm_campaign %>% select(-farms))

# Check unique farms
all_farms <- unique(leaf_data_converted$Ferme)
cat("\nTotal unique farms across all campaigns:", length(all_farms), "\n")
print("Unique farms:")
print(all_farms)
```

## I.6. Missing Data Analysis

```{r}
#4. DETAILED MISSING DATA ANALYSIS
# ===============================
cat("\n4. DETAILED MISSING DATA ANALYSIS\n")
cat("==================================\n")

# Overall missing data summary
missing_summary <- leaf_data_converted %>%
  summarise_all(~sum(is.na(.))) %>%
  gather(key = "variable", value = "missing_count") %>%
  mutate(
    missing_percentage = round((missing_count / nrow(leaf_data_converted)) * 100, 2),
    variable_type = case_when(
      variable %in% existing_factors ~ "Factor",
      variable %in% existing_dates ~ "Date", 
      variable %in% existing_numerics ~ "Numeric",
      TRUE ~ "Unclassified"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(missing_count))

print("COMPLETE MISSING DATA SUMMARY:")
print(missing_summary)

# Missing data by variable type
cat("\nMISSING DATA BY VARIABLE TYPE:\n")
missing_by_type <- missing_summary %>%
  group_by(variable_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n_variables = n(),
    total_missing = sum(missing_count),
    avg_missing_pct = round(mean(missing_percentage), 2),
    max_missing_pct = max(missing_percentage),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )
print(missing_by_type)

# Variables with high missing rates (>50%)
high_missing <- missing_summary %>%
  filter(missing_percentage > 50) %>%
  arrange(desc(missing_percentage))

if(nrow(high_missing) > 0) {
  cat("\nVARIABLES WITH HIGH MISSING RATES (>50%):\n")
  print(high_missing)
} else {
  cat("\nNo variables with >50% missing values found.\n")
}

# ===============================
# 5. FACTOR VARIABLES ANALYSIS
# ===============================
cat("\n5. FACTOR VARIABLES ANALYSIS\n")
cat("============================\n")

for(var in existing_factors) {
  if(var %in% names(leaf_data_converted)) {
    cat("\n--- FACTOR:", var, "---\n")
    var_summary <- leaf_data_converted %>%
      count(.data[[var]], name = "count") %>%
      mutate(percentage = round(count/sum(count)*100, 2)) %>%
      arrange(desc(count))
    
    cat("Levels:", nlevels(leaf_data_converted[[var]]), "\n")
    cat("Missing values:", sum(is.na(leaf_data_converted[[var]])), "\n")
    print("Distribution (top 10):")
    print(head(var_summary, 10))
  }
}

# ===============================
# 6. NUMERICAL VARIABLES ANALYSIS
# ===============================
cat("\n6. NUMERICAL VARIABLES ANALYSIS\n")
cat("===============================\n")

if(length(existing_numerics) > 0) {
  # Comprehensive numeric summary
  numeric_data <- leaf_data_converted %>% select(all_of(existing_numerics))
  
  cat("SUMMARY STATISTICS FOR ALL NUMERICAL VARIABLES:\n")
  print(summary(numeric_data))
  
  # Detailed analysis for each numeric variable
  cat("\nDETAILED NUMERICAL ANALYSIS:\n")
  for(var in existing_numerics) {
    if(var %in% names(leaf_data_converted)) {
      cat("\n--- NUMERIC VARIABLE:", var, "---\n")
      
      var_data <- leaf_data_converted[[var]]
      non_na_data <- var_data[!is.na(var_data)]
      
      if(length(non_na_data) > 0) {
        cat("Missing values:", sum(is.na(var_data)), "(", 
            round(sum(is.na(var_data))/length(var_data)*100, 2), "%)\n")
        cat("Non-missing values:", length(non_na_data), "\n")
        cat("Min:", min(non_na_data), "\n")
        cat("Q1:", quantile(non_na_data, 0.25), "\n")
        cat("Median:", median(non_na_data), "\n")
        cat("Mean:", round(mean(non_na_data), 3), "\n")
        cat("Q3:", quantile(non_na_data, 0.75), "\n")
        cat("Max:", max(non_na_data), "\n")
        cat("Std Dev:", round(sd(non_na_data), 3), "\n")
        
        # Check for outliers (values beyond 1.5 * IQR)
        Q1 <- quantile(non_na_data, 0.25)
        Q3 <- quantile(non_na_data, 0.75)
        IQR <- Q3 - Q1
        outliers <- non_na_data[non_na_data < (Q1 - 1.5*IQR) | non_na_data > (Q3 + 1.5*IQR)]
        cat("Potential outliers:", length(outliers), "\n")
        if(length(outliers) > 0 && length(outliers) <= 10) {
          cat("Outlier values:", paste(round(outliers, 3), collapse = ", "), "\n")
        }
        
        # Zero values
        zero_count <- sum(non_na_data == 0)
        if(zero_count > 0) {
          cat("Zero values:", zero_count, "(", round(zero_count/length(non_na_data)*100, 2), "%)\n")
        }
        
        # Negative values
        neg_count <- sum(non_na_data < 0)
        if(neg_count > 0) {
          cat("Negative values:", neg_count, "(", round(neg_count/length(non_na_data)*100, 2), "%)\n")
        }
      } else {
        cat("No non-missing values found for", var, "\n")
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
print(head(row_completeness %>% arrange(desc(completeness_pct)), 5))
```

# II. Dataset Integration (Three-Dataset Parcel-Year LinkageThree-Dataset Parcel-Year Linkage)

Creating normalized parcel-year keys by converting parcel names to uppercase and extracting campaign years (e.g., "2011-2012" → 2011 for leaf data, "03-04" → 2003 for yield data). Performing three-way joins to identify: (1) complete matches present in all datasets, (2) two-way overlaps (yield+soil, yield+leaf, soil+leaf), and (3) unique records per dataset.

```{r}
head(leaf_data_converted) 
# Unique and sorted
unique_parc. <- sort(unique(leaf_data_converted$Parc.))
unique_parcelle <- sort(unique(data$Parcelle))
unique_parc_detaillee <- sort(unique(soil_data$Parc.Detaillee))

# Display with numbering
cat("📌 Unique Parc. values:\n")
for (i in seq_along(unique_parc.)) {
  cat(paste0(i, ". ", unique_parc.[i], "\n"))
}

cat("\n📌 Unique Parcelle values:\n")
for (i in seq_along(unique_parcelle)) {
  cat(paste0(i, ". ", unique_parcelle[i], "\n"))
}

cat("📌 Unique Parc.Detaillee values:\n")
for (i in seq_along(unique_parc_detaillee)) {
  cat(paste0(i, ". ", unique_parc_detaillee[i], "\n"))
}
```

## II.1. Data Integration (All Uppercase)

```{r}
# Step 1: Convert to uppercase
soil_data$Parc.Detaillee <- toupper(soil_data$Parc.Detaillee)
data$Parcelle <- toupper(data$Parcelle)
leaf_data_converted$Parc. <- toupper(leaf_data_converted$Parc.)

# Step 2: Get unique sorted values
unique_parc_detaillee <- sort(unique(soil_data$Parc.Detaillee))
unique_parcelle <- sort(unique(data$Parcelle))
```

```{r}
# Step 2: Count frequencies

# Step 3: Display the frequencies nicely
cat("📊 Frequency of each unique 'Parc.Detaillee' in soil_data:\n")

for (i in seq_along(soil_freq)) {

}

cat("\n📊 Frequency of each unique 'Parcelle' in data:\n")
cat(paste0("Total unique values: ", length(data_freq), "\n\n"))

cat(paste0("Total unique values: ", length(leaf_freq), "\n\n"))
for (i in seq_along(leaf_freq)) {

}

# Step 4: Standardize inputs to uppercase for matching

yield_parcels <- toupper(unique(data$Parcelle))
leaf_parcels <- toupper(unique(leaf_data_converted$Parc.))

# Step 5: Matching statistics
common_all_three <- Reduce(intersect, list(soil_parcels, yield_parcels, leaf_parcels))
common_soil_yield <- intersect(soil_parcels, yield_parcels)
common_soil_leaf <- intersect(soil_parcels, leaf_parcels)
common_yield_leaf <- intersect(yield_parcels, leaf_parcels)

only_soil <- setdiff(soil_parcels, union(yield_parcels, leaf_parcels))
only_yield <- setdiff(yield_parcels, union(soil_parcels, leaf_parcels))
only_leaf <- setdiff(leaf_parcels, union(soil_parcels, yield_parcels))

# Step 6: Display results

cat("• Total unique parcels in YIELD data :", length(yield_parcels), "\n")

cat("• ✅ Common to YIELD & LEAF only     :", length(common_yield_leaf), "\n")

cat("• ❌ Parcels only in LEAF data       :", length(only_leaf), "\n")

# Step 7: Display samples of mismatches

} else {

}
```

```{r}
# === LEAF DATA ===

  )

# Check the campaign conversion
```

## II.3. Not trimmed (space preserved)

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)
library(dplyr)

# === VERSION 1: TWO-WAY PLOTS (Uppercase, Spaces Preserved) ===

# First, create normalized versions with uppercase but spaces preserved
data_twoway <- data %>%
  mutate(Parcelle_norm = str_to_upper(Parcelle))

soil_data_twoway <- soil_data %>%
  mutate(
    Parc.Detaillee_norm = str_to_upper(Parc.Detaillee),
    Annee = as.numeric(Annee)
  )

# Create keys for two-way analysis
yield_keys_twoway <- data_twoway %>%
  distinct(Parcelle_norm, year_start) %>%
  rename(Year = year_start, Parcel = Parcelle_norm)

soil_keys_twoway <- soil_data_twoway %>%
  distinct(Parc.Detaillee_norm, Annee) %>%
  rename(Year = Annee, Parcel = Parc.Detaillee_norm)

# Two-way matching
common_keys_twoway <- inner_join(yield_keys_twoway, soil_keys_twoway, by = c("Parcel", "Year"))
only_in_yield_twoway <- anti_join(yield_keys_twoway, soil_keys_twoway, by = c("Parcel", "Year"))
only_in_soil_twoway <- anti_join(soil_keys_twoway, yield_keys_twoway, by = c("Parcel", "Year"))

# Prepare data for two-way plotting
linkage_counts_twoway <- tibble(
  Category = c("Yield Only", "Soil Only", "Common"),
  Count = c(nrow(only_in_yield_twoway), nrow(only_in_soil_twoway), nrow(common_keys_twoway))
)

# ---- 1. Bar plot: Two-way Parcel-Year linkage summary ----
plot_linkage_twoway <- ggplot(linkage_counts_twoway, aes(x = Category, y = Count, fill = Category)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::comma(Count)), vjust = -0.5, size = 5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Yield Only" = "#1f78b4", "Soil Only" = "#33a02c", "Common" = "#6a3d9a")) +
  labs(title = "Two-Way Parcel-Year Linkage Summary",
       subtitle = paste0("Yield unique: ", scales::comma(nrow(yield_keys_twoway)),
                         " | Soil unique: ", scales::comma(nrow(soil_keys_twoway))),
       x = NULL,
       y = "Number of Unique Parcel-Year Pairs") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"))

# ---- 2. Two-way Year distribution plots ----
yield_year_dist_twoway <- yield_keys_twoway %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(Parcel_Count = n()) %>%
  ungroup()

plot_yield_year_twoway <- ggplot(yield_year_dist_twoway, aes(x = Year, y = Parcel_Count)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#1f78b4") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = pretty(yield_year_dist_twoway$Year, 10)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(title = "Yield Data: Parcel-Year Counts by Year",
       x = "Year",
       y = "Number of Unique Parcels") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

soil_year_dist_twoway <- soil_keys_twoway %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(Parcel_Count = n()) %>%
  ungroup()

plot_soil_year_twoway <- ggplot(soil_year_dist_twoway, aes(x = Year, y = Parcel_Count)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#33a02c") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = pretty(soil_year_dist_twoway$Year, 10)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(title = "Soil Data: Parcel-Year Counts by Year",
       x = "Year",
       y = "Number of Unique Parcels") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

# ---- 3. Two-way Pie chart ----
plot_pie_twoway <- ggplot(linkage_counts_twoway, aes(x = "", y = Count, fill = Category)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, color = "white") +
  coord_polar("y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Yield Only" = "#1f78b4", "Soil Only" = "#33a02c", "Common" = "#6a3d9a")) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(Category, "\n", scales::percent(Count / sum(Count), accuracy = 0.1))),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 4) +
  labs(title = "Two-Way Linkage Proportions") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))

# === VERSION 2: THREE-WAY PLOTS (Uppercase, Spaces Preserved) ===

# Create normalized leaf data with spaces preserved
leaf_data_twoway <- leaf_data_converted %>%
  mutate(
    year_start = as.numeric(str_extract(Campagne, "^\\d{4}")),
    Parc_norm = str_to_upper(Parc.)
  )

# Create keys for three-way analysis
leaf_keys_twoway <- leaf_data_twoway %>%
  distinct(Parc_norm, year_start) %>%
  rename(Year = year_start, Parcel = Parc_norm)

# === DETAILED THREE-WAY ANALYSIS ===
cat("=== Detailed Three-Way Overlap Analysis ===\n")

# Print unique key counts
cat("Total unique parcel-year pairs per dataset:\n")
cat("• Yield dataset:", nrow(yield_keys_twoway), "unique parcel-year pairs\n")
cat("• Soil dataset: ", nrow(soil_keys_twoway), "unique parcel-year pairs\n")
cat("• Leaf dataset: ", nrow(leaf_keys_twoway), "unique parcel-year pairs\n\n")

# Find all possible overlaps using Venn diagram logic
# 1. Common to all three datasets (intersection of all three)
common_all_three_twoway <- yield_keys_twoway %>%
  inner_join(soil_keys_twoway, by = c("Parcel", "Year")) %>%
  inner_join(leaf_keys_twoway, by = c("Parcel", "Year"))

# 2. Common to exactly two datasets (but NOT in the third)
yield_soil_only <- yield_keys_twoway %>%
  inner_join(soil_keys_twoway, by = c("Parcel", "Year")) %>%
  anti_join(leaf_keys_twoway, by = c("Parcel", "Year"))

yield_leaf_only <- yield_keys_twoway %>%
  inner_join(leaf_keys_twoway, by = c("Parcel", "Year")) %>%
  anti_join(soil_keys_twoway, by = c("Parcel", "Year"))

soil_leaf_only <- soil_keys_twoway %>%
  inner_join(leaf_keys_twoway, by = c("Parcel", "Year")) %>%
  anti_join(yield_keys_twoway, by = c("Parcel", "Year"))

# 3. Unique to exactly one dataset (not in any other)
yield_only <- yield_keys_twoway %>%
  anti_join(soil_keys_twoway, by = c("Parcel", "Year")) %>%
  anti_join(leaf_keys_twoway, by = c("Parcel", "Year"))

soil_only <- soil_keys_twoway %>%
  anti_join(yield_keys_twoway, by = c("Parcel", "Year")) %>%
  anti_join(leaf_keys_twoway, by = c("Parcel", "Year"))

leaf_only <- leaf_keys_twoway %>%
  anti_join(yield_keys_twoway, by = c("Parcel", "Year")) %>%
  anti_join(soil_keys_twoway, by = c("Parcel", "Year"))

# Print detailed results
cat("OVERLAP ANALYSIS:\n")
cat("• Common to ALL THREE datasets     :", nrow(common_all_three_twoway), "pairs\n")
cat("• Common to Yield+Soil only        :", nrow(yield_soil_only), "pairs\n")
cat("• Common to Yield+Leaf only        :", nrow(yield_leaf_only), "pairs\n")
cat("• Common to Soil+Leaf only         :", nrow(soil_leaf_only), "pairs\n")
cat("• Unique to Yield only             :", nrow(yield_only), "pairs\n")
cat("• Unique to Soil only              :", nrow(soil_only), "pairs\n")
cat("• Unique to Leaf only              :", nrow(leaf_only), "pairs\n\n")

# Calculate linkable data (parcel-years that appear in all three datasets)
total_potential_links <- nrow(common_all_three_twoway)
total_unlinkable <- nrow(yield_only) + nrow(soil_only) + nrow(leaf_only) + 
                   nrow(yield_soil_only) + nrow(yield_leaf_only) + nrow(soil_leaf_only)

cat("LINKAGE SUMMARY:\n")
cat("• ✅ FULLY LINKABLE (all 3 datasets):", total_potential_links, "parcel-year pairs\n")
cat("• ❌ NOT FULLY LINKABLE              :", total_unlinkable, "parcel-year pairs\n")
cat("• 📊 Linkage success rate           :", 
    round(total_potential_links / (total_potential_links + total_unlinkable) * 100, 1), "%\n\n")

# Show samples of fully linkable data
cat("Sample of FULLY LINKABLE parcel-year pairs:\n")
print(head(common_all_three_twoway, 10))

# Prepare data for three-way plotting
linkage_counts_threeway <- tibble(
  Category = c("All Three\n(Linkable)", "Yield+Soil Only", "Yield+Leaf Only", "Soil+Leaf Only", 
               "Yield Only", "Soil Only", "Leaf Only"),
  Count = c(nrow(common_all_three_twoway), nrow(yield_soil_only), 
            nrow(yield_leaf_only), nrow(soil_leaf_only),
            nrow(yield_only), nrow(soil_only), nrow(leaf_only)),
  Linkable = c("Yes", "No", "No", "No", "No", "No", "No")
)

# ---- 4. Three-way Bar plot ----
plot_linkage_threeway <- ggplot(linkage_counts_threeway, aes(x = reorder(Category, Count), y = Count, fill = Linkable)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, show.legend = TRUE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::comma(Count)), hjust = -0.1, size = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Yes" = "#2E8B57", "No" = "#DC143C"), 
                    name = "Fully Linkable", 
                    labels = c("No" = "Not Linkable", "Yes" = "Linkable")) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Three-Way Parcel-Year Linkage Analysis",
       subtitle = paste0("Linkable pairs: ", scales::comma(total_potential_links), " | ",
                         "Non-linkable pairs: ", scales::comma(total_unlinkable), " | ",
                         "Success rate: ", round(total_potential_links / (total_potential_links + total_unlinkable) * 100, 1), "%"),
       x = NULL,
       y = "Number of Unique Parcel-Year Pairs") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "bottom")

# ---- 5. Three-way Year distributions ----
leaf_year_dist_twoway <- leaf_keys_twoway %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(Parcel_Count = n()) %>%
  ungroup()

plot_leaf_year_twoway <- ggplot(leaf_year_dist_twoway, aes(x = Year, y = Parcel_Count)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#fdbf6f") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = pretty(leaf_year_dist_twoway$Year, 10)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(title = "Leaf Data: Parcel-Year Counts by Year",
       x = "Year",
       y = "Number of Unique Parcels") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

# Combined three-way year plot
plot_year_combined_threeway <- plot_yield_year_twoway / plot_soil_year_twoway / plot_leaf_year_twoway +
  plot_annotation(title = "Yearly Distribution of Unique Parcel-Year Combinations (Three Datasets)",
                  theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")))

# ---- 6. Create final layouts ----
cat("=== Creating Two-Way Analysis Plots ===\n")
plot_year_combined_twoway <- plot_yield_year_twoway | plot_soil_year_twoway + 
  plot_annotation(title = "Two-Way Yearly Distribution",
                  theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")))

final_plot_twoway <- plot_linkage_twoway | plot_pie_twoway
combined_plot_twoway <- final_plot_twoway / plot_year_combined_twoway + 
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 2)) +
  plot_annotation(caption = "Two-way analysis: Uppercase parcel names, spaces preserved.",
                  theme = theme(plot.caption = element_text(size = 11, face = "italic")))

cat("=== Creating Three-Way Analysis Plots ===\n")
final_plot_threeway <- plot_linkage_threeway | plot_year_combined_threeway + 
  plot_layout(widths = c(1.2, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(caption = "Three-way analysis: Uppercase parcel names, spaces preserved.",
                  theme = theme(plot.caption = element_text(size = 11, face = "italic")))

# ---- Print plots ----
print("Two-Way Analysis:")
print(combined_plot_twoway)

print("\nThree-Way Analysis:")
print(final_plot_threeway)
```

## II.4. Correspondence Summary

i\. Complete Matches Identifying parcel-year pairs present in all three datasets for integrated analysis.

ii. Partial and Unique Records Documenting dataset-specific observations for selective analyses.

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# === PRÉPARATION DES DONNÉES ===

# Normalisation des données avec majuscules et espaces préservés
data_norm <- data %>%
  mutate(Parcelle_norm = str_to_upper(Parcelle))

soil_data_norm <- soil_data %>%
  mutate(
    Parc.Detaillee_norm = str_to_upper(Parc.Detaillee),
    Annee = as.numeric(Annee)
  )

leaf_data_norm <- leaf_data_converted %>%
  mutate(
    year_start = as.numeric(str_extract(Campagne, "^\\d{4}")),
    Parc_norm = str_to_upper(Parc.)
  )

# Création des clés uniques pour chaque jeu de données
yield_keys <- data_norm %>%
  distinct(Parcelle_norm, year_start) %>%
  rename(Annee = year_start, Parcelle = Parcelle_norm)

soil_keys <- soil_data_norm %>%
  distinct(Parc.Detaillee_norm, Annee) %>%
  rename(Parcelle = Parc.Detaillee_norm)

leaf_keys <- leaf_data_norm %>%
  distinct(Parc_norm, year_start) %>%
  rename(Annee = year_start, Parcelle = Parc_norm)

# === ANALYSE DES CORRESPONDANCES TOTALES ===

# Correspondances complètes (présentes dans les trois jeux de données)
correspondance_complete <- yield_keys %>%
  inner_join(soil_keys, by = c("Parcelle", "Annee")) %>%
  inner_join(leaf_keys, by = c("Parcelle", "Annee"))

# Correspondances à deux voies (incluant celles qui sont aussi dans le 3ème)
rendement_sol_total <- yield_keys %>%
  inner_join(soil_keys, by = c("Parcelle", "Annee"))

rendement_feuille_total <- yield_keys %>%
  inner_join(leaf_keys, by = c("Parcelle", "Annee"))

sol_feuille_total <- soil_keys %>%
  inner_join(leaf_keys, by = c("Parcelle", "Annee"))

# Données uniques (présentes dans un seul jeu de données)
unique_rendement <- yield_keys %>%
  anti_join(soil_keys, by = c("Parcelle", "Annee")) %>%
  anti_join(leaf_keys, by = c("Parcelle", "Annee"))

unique_sol <- soil_keys %>%
  anti_join(yield_keys, by = c("Parcelle", "Annee")) %>%
  anti_join(leaf_keys, by = c("Parcelle", "Annee"))

unique_feuille <- leaf_keys %>%
  anti_join(yield_keys, by = c("Parcelle", "Annee")) %>%
  anti_join(soil_keys, by = c("Parcelle", "Annee"))

# Configuration du thème académique français
theme_academique_fr <- theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", size = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0, face = "italic")
  )

# === GRAPHIQUE 1: CORRESPONDANCES TOTALES ===

donnees_correspondance_totales <- tibble(
  Categorie = c("Trois jeux\n(Correspondance complète)", 
                "Rendement + Sol", 
                "Rendement + Feuille", 
                "Sol + Feuille"),
  Nombre = c(nrow(correspondance_complete), 
             nrow(rendement_sol_total), 
             nrow(rendement_feuille_total), 
             nrow(sol_feuille_total)),
  Type = c("Complète", "Partielle", "Partielle", "Partielle")
)

graphique_correspondances_totales <- ggplot(donnees_correspondance_totales, 
                                           aes(x = reorder(Categorie, Nombre), y = Nombre, fill = Type)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "white", size = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0("n = ", format(Nombre, big.mark = " "))), 
            hjust = -0.1, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Complète" = "#2E8B57", "Partielle" = "#4682B4"),
                    name = "Type de correspondance") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Correspondances totales entre jeux de données",
    subtitle = "Nombre total de couples parcelle-année présents dans chaque combinaison",
    x = "Catégories de correspondance",
    y = "Nombre de couples parcelle-année uniques",
    caption = "Note : Les correspondances à 2 jeux incluent celles présentes aussi dans le 3ème jeu"
  ) +
  theme_academique_fr +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) format(x, big.mark = " "))

# === GRAPHIQUE 2: RÉPARTITION PAR JEU DE DONNÉES ===

donnees_jeux <- tibble(
  Jeu_donnees = c("Rendement", "Sol", "Feuilles"),
  Nombre_total = c(nrow(yield_keys), nrow(soil_keys), nrow(leaf_keys)),
  Dans_correspondance_complete = c(
    sum(yield_keys %>% semi_join(correspondance_complete, by = c("Parcelle", "Annee")) %>% nrow()),
    sum(soil_keys %>% semi_join(correspondance_complete, by = c("Parcelle", "Annee")) %>% nrow()),
    sum(leaf_keys %>% semi_join(correspondance_complete, by = c("Parcelle", "Annee")) %>% nrow())
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    Taux_correspondance = Dans_correspondance_complete / Nombre_total * 100,
    Uniquement_jeu = Nombre_total - Dans_correspondance_complete
  )

# Reformater pour ggplot
donnees_jeux_long <- donnees_jeux %>%
  select(Jeu_donnees, Dans_correspondance_complete, Uniquement_jeu) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Dans_correspondance_complete, Uniquement_jeu),
               names_to = "Statut", values_to = "Nombre") %>%
  mutate(
    Statut = case_when(
      Statut == "Dans_correspondance_complete" ~ "Dans correspondance\ncomplète",
      Statut == "Uniquement_jeu" ~ "Unique à ce jeu"
    )
  )

graphique_jeux <- ggplot(donnees_jeux_long, aes(x = Jeu_donnees, y = Nombre, fill = Statut)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack", width = 0.7, color = "white", size = 0.5) +
  geom_text(data = donnees_jeux, 
            aes(x = Jeu_donnees, y = Nombre_total + 50, 
                label = paste0(round(Taux_correspondance, 1), "%")),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Dans correspondance\ncomplète" = "#2E8B57", 
                              "Unique à ce jeu" = "#DC143C"),
                    name = "Statut des données") +
  labs(
    title = "Répartition des données par jeu",
    subtitle = "Proportion des données présentes dans la correspondance complète",
    x = "Jeux de données",
    y = "Nombre de couples parcelle-année",
    caption = "Pourcentages indiqués : taux de présence dans la correspondance complète"
  ) +
  theme_academique_fr +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) format(x, big.mark = " "))

# === GRAPHIQUE 3: RÉPARTITION PROPORTIONNELLE ===

donnees_proportion <- tibble(
  Categorie = c("Correspondance\ncomplète", "Données\nuniques"),
  Nombre = c(nrow(correspondance_complete),
             nrow(unique_rendement) + nrow(unique_sol) + nrow(unique_feuille)),
  Couleur = c("#2E8B57", "#DC143C")
)

graphique_proportion <- ggplot(donnees_proportion, aes(x = "", y = Nombre, fill = Categorie)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, color = "white", size = 0.8) +
  coord_polar("y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(donnees_proportion$Couleur, donnees_proportion$Categorie)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(format(Nombre, big.mark = " "), "\n(", 
                               round(Nombre/sum(Nombre)*100, 1), "%)")),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), 
            size = 3.5, fontface = "bold", color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "Répartition générale",
    fill = "Type de données"
  ) +
  theme_academique_fr +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank()
  )

# === GRAPHIQUE 4: ÉVOLUTION TEMPORELLE DES CORRESPONDANCES ===

# Analyse par année des correspondances complètes
correspondances_annuelles <- correspondance_complete %>%
  count(Annee, name = "Correspondances_completes") %>%
  full_join(
    yield_keys %>% count(Annee, name = "Total_rendement"),
    by = "Annee"
  ) %>%
  full_join(
    soil_keys %>% count(Annee, name = "Total_sol"),
    by = "Annee"
  ) %>%
  full_join(
    leaf_keys %>% count(Annee, name = "Total_feuille"),
    by = "Annee"
  ) %>%
  replace_na(list(Correspondances_completes = 0, Total_rendement = 0, 
                  Total_sol = 0, Total_feuille = 0)) %>%
  mutate(
    Taux_correspondance = ifelse(pmax(Total_rendement, Total_sol, Total_feuille, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                                Correspondances_completes / pmax(Total_rendement, Total_sol, Total_feuille, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
                                0)
  )

graphique_temporel <- ggplot(correspondances_annuelles, aes(x = Annee)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = Correspondances_completes), fill = "#2E8B57", alpha = 0.8, width = 0.8) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Taux_correspondance * max(Correspondances_completes, na.rm = TRUE) / 100), 
            color = "#DC143C", size = 1.2, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(y = Taux_correspondance * max(Correspondances_completes, na.rm = TRUE) / 100), 
             color = "#DC143C", size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(correspondances_annuelles$Annee, na.rm = TRUE), 
                                  max(correspondances_annuelles$Annee, na.rm = TRUE), by = 2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Nombre de correspondances complètes",
    labels = function(x) format(x, big.mark = " "),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . * 100 / max(correspondances_annuelles$Correspondances_completes, na.rm = TRUE), 
                       name = "Taux de correspondance (%)")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Évolution temporelle des correspondances complètes",
    subtitle = "Nombre de couples parcelle-année présents dans les trois jeux de données",
    x = "Année",
    caption = "Barres : nombre de correspondances | Ligne : taux de correspondance"
  ) +
  theme_academique_fr +
  theme(
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "#DC143C", face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y.right = element_text(color = "#DC143C")
  )

# === CRÉATION DU GRAPHIQUE COMBINÉ ===

graphique_combine <- (graphique_correspondances_totales | graphique_jeux) / 
                     (graphique_proportion | graphique_temporel) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "ANALYSE DES CORRESPONDANCES TOTALES ENTRE JEUX DE DONNÉES AGRICOLES",
    subtitle = paste0("Analyse comparative des données de rendement, sol et feuilles | ",
                     "Correspondances complètes : ", format(nrow(correspondance_complete), big.mark = " "), 
                     " couples parcelle-année"),
    caption = paste0("Note : Correspondance complète = présence dans les trois jeux de données (rendement, sol, feuilles)\n",
                    "Les correspondances partielles incluent les chevauchements avec le troisième jeu\n",
                    "Période d'analyse : ", min(c(yield_keys$Annee, soil_keys$Annee, leaf_keys$Annee), na.rm = TRUE),
                    " - ", max(c(yield_keys$Annee, soil_keys$Annee, leaf_keys$Annee), na.rm = TRUE)),
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0, face = "italic")
    )
  )

# === SAUVEGARDE DES GRAPHIQUES ===

# Créer le dossier de sortie s'il n'existe pas
if (!dir.exists("graphiques_correspondances_totales")) {
  dir.create("graphiques_correspondances_totales")
}

# Sauvegarde du graphique combiné principal
ggsave(
  filename = "graphiques_correspondances_totales/analyse_correspondances_totales.png",

# Sauvegarde des graphiques individuels

ggsave(

ggsave(

# === STATISTIQUES DESCRIPTIVES ===

cat("=== RÉSUMÉ DE L'ANALYSE DES CORRESPONDANCES TOTALES ===\n\n")

cat("JEUX DE DONNÉES UNIQUES :\n")
cat("• Rendement :", format(nrow(yield_keys), big.mark = " "), "couples parcelle-année\n")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# === PRÉPARATION DES DONNÉES ===

# Normalisation des données avec majuscules et espaces préservés
data_norm <- data %>%
  mutate(Parcelle_norm = str_to_upper(Parcelle))

soil_data_norm <- soil_data %>%
  mutate(
    Parc.Detaillee_norm = str_to_upper(Parc.Detaillee),
    Annee = as.numeric(Annee)
  )

leaf_data_norm <- leaf_data_converted %>%
  mutate(
    year_start = as.numeric(str_extract(Campagne, "^\\d{4}")),
    Parc_norm = str_to_upper(Parc.)
  )

# Création des clés uniques pour chaque jeu de données
yield_keys <- data_norm %>%
  distinct(Parcelle_norm, year_start) %>%
  rename(Annee = year_start, Parcelle = Parcelle_norm)

soil_keys <- soil_data_norm %>%
  distinct(Parc.Detaillee_norm, Annee) %>%
  rename(Parcelle = Parc.Detaillee_norm)

leaf_keys <- leaf_data_norm %>%
  distinct(Parc_norm, year_start) %>%
  rename(Annee = year_start, Parcelle = Parc_norm)

# === FONCTION POUR GÉNÉRER DES ÉCHANTILLONS ===
generer_echantillons <- function(data, nom_dataset, n_sample = 10) {
  if (nrow(data) == 0) {
    return(paste0("Aucune donnée disponible pour ", nom_dataset))
  }
  
  echantillon <- data %>%
    sample_n(min(n_sample, nrow(data))) %>%
    arrange(Annee, Parcelle) %>%
    mutate(ligne = paste0("  • ", Parcelle, " (", Annee, ")"))
  
  return(echantillon$ligne)
}

# === CORRESPONDANCES POUR IDENTIFIER LES DONNÉES UNIQUES ===

# Correspondances complètes (présentes dans les trois jeux de données)
correspondance_complete <- yield_keys %>%
  inner_join(soil_keys, by = c("Parcelle", "Annee")) %>%
  inner_join(leaf_keys, by = c("Parcelle", "Annee"))

# Données uniques (présentes dans un seul jeu de données)
unique_rendement <- yield_keys %>%
  anti_join(soil_keys, by = c("Parcelle", "Annee")) %>%
  anti_join(leaf_keys, by = c("Parcelle", "Annee"))

unique_sol <- soil_keys %>%
  anti_join(yield_keys, by = c("Parcelle", "Annee")) %>%
  anti_join(leaf_keys, by = c("Parcelle", "Annee"))

unique_feuille <- leaf_keys %>%
  anti_join(yield_keys, by = c("Parcelle", "Annee")) %>%
  anti_join(soil_keys, by = c("Parcelle", "Annee"))

# === ANALYSE DES PLAGES TEMPORELLES ===

analyser_plage_temporelle <- function(data, nom_dataset) {
  if (nrow(data) == 0) {
    return(list(
      min_annee = NA,
      max_annee = NA,
      nb_annees = 0,
      annees_manquantes = NA,
      resume = paste0("Aucune donnée pour ", nom_dataset)
    ))
  }
  
  min_annee <- min(data$Annee, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_annee <- max(data$Annee, na.rm = TRUE)
  annees_presentes <- sort(unique(data$Annee))
  annees_completes <- seq(min_annee, max_annee)
  annees_manquantes <- setdiff(annees_completes, annees_presentes)
  
  return(list(
    min_annee = min_annee,
    max_annee = max_annee,
    nb_annees = length(annees_presentes),
    nb_annees_possibles = length(annees_completes),
    annees_presentes = annees_presentes,
    annees_manquantes = annees_manquantes,
    taux_completude = round(length(annees_presentes) / length(annees_completes) * 100, 1)
  ))
}

# Analyse des plages temporelles pour chaque jeu de données
plage_rendement <- analyser_plage_temporelle(yield_keys, "Rendement")
plage_sol <- analyser_plage_temporelle(soil_keys, "Sol")
plage_feuille <- analyser_plage_temporelle(leaf_keys, "Feuilles")
plage_correspondance_complete <- analyser_plage_temporelle(correspondance_complete, "Correspondance complète")

# === ANALYSE DES PARCELLES UNIQUES ===

analyser_parcelles <- function(data, nom_dataset) {
  if (nrow(data) == 0) {
    return(list(
      nb_parcelles_uniques = 0,
      parcelles_les_plus_frequentes = character(0),
      resume = paste0("Aucune parcelle pour ", nom_dataset)
    ))
  }
  
  parcelles_freq <- data %>%
    count(Parcelle, sort = TRUE)
  
  return(list(
    nb_parcelles_uniques = nrow(parcelles_freq),
    parcelles_les_plus_frequentes = head(parcelles_freq, 5),
    nb_observations_total = nrow(data)
  ))
}

parcelles_rendement <- analyser_parcelles(yield_keys, "Rendement")
parcelles_sol <- analyser_parcelles(soil_keys, "Sol")
parcelles_feuille <- analyser_parcelles(leaf_keys, "Feuilles")

# === 1. STATISTIQUES GÉNÉRALES ===
cat("📊 STATISTIQUES GÉNÉRALES\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("TOTAL DES OBSERVATIONS PAR JEU DE DONNÉES :\n")
cat("• Rendement :", format(nrow(yield_keys), big.mark = " "), "couples parcelle-année\n")
cat("• Sol       :", format(nrow(soil_keys), big.mark = " "), "couples parcelle-année\n")
cat("• Feuilles  :", format(nrow(leaf_keys), big.mark = " "), "couples parcelle-année\n")
cat("• Correspondance complète :", format(nrow(correspondance_complete), big.mark = " "), "couples parcelle-année\n\n")

cat("NOMBRE DE PARCELLES UNIQUES PAR JEU :\n")
cat("• Rendement :", format(parcelles_rendement$nb_parcelles_uniques, big.mark = " "), "parcelles\n")

# === 2. PLAGES TEMPORELLES ===
cat("📅 PLAGES TEMPORELLES\n")
cat("══════════════════════\n\n")

afficher_plage <- function(plage, nom) {
  cat(paste0("▶ ", nom, " :\n"))
  if (is.na(plage$min_annee)) {
    cat("  Aucune donnée disponible\n\n")
    return()
  }
  
  cat("  • Période :", plage$min_annee, "-", plage$max_annee, 
      "(", plage$max_annee - plage$min_annee + 1, "ans de couverture possible)\n")
  cat("  • Années avec données :", plage$nb_annees, "/", plage$nb_annees_possibles,
      "(", plage$taux_completude, "% de complétude temporelle)\n")
  
  if (length(plage$annees_manquantes) > 0 && length(plage$annees_manquantes) <= 10) {
    cat("  • Années manquantes :", paste(plage$annees_manquantes, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  } else if (length(plage$annees_manquantes) > 10) {
    cat("  • Années manquantes :", length(plage$annees_manquantes), "années (",
        paste(head(plage$annees_manquantes, 3), collapse = ", "), "...)\n")
  } else {
    cat("  • Couverture temporelle complète ✓\n")
  }
  cat("\n")
}

afficher_plage(plage_rendement, "DONNÉES DE RENDEMENT")
afficher_plage(plage_sol, "DONNÉES DE SOL")
afficher_plage(plage_feuille, "DONNÉES DE FEUILLES")
afficher_plage(plage_correspondance_complete, "CORRESPONDANCE COMPLÈTE")

# === 3. DONNÉES UNIQUES (présentes dans un seul jeu) ===
cat("🔍 DONNÉES UNIQUES (présentes dans un seul jeu de données)\n")
cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

cat("▶ RENDEMENT UNIQUEMENT :\n")
cat("  Nombre :", format(nrow(unique_rendement), big.mark = " "), "couples parcelle-année\n")
if (nrow(unique_rendement) > 0) {
  cat("  Échantillons :\n")
  echantillons <- generer_echantillons(unique_rendement, "Rendement")
  cat(paste(echantillons, collapse = "\n"), "\n")
} else {
  cat("  Aucune donnée unique au jeu de rendement\n")
}
cat("\n")

cat("▶ SOL UNIQUEMENT :\n")
cat("  Nombre :", format(nrow(unique_sol), big.mark = " "), "couples parcelle-année\n")
if (nrow(unique_sol) > 0) {
  cat("  Échantillons :\n")
  echantillons <- generer_echantillons(unique_sol, "Sol")
  cat(paste(echantillons, collapse = "\n"), "\n")
} else {
  cat("  Aucune donnée unique au jeu de sol\n")
}
cat("\n")

cat("▶ FEUILLES UNIQUEMENT :\n")
cat("  Nombre :", format(nrow(unique_feuille), big.mark = " "), "couples parcelle-année\n")
if (nrow(unique_feuille) > 0) {
  cat("  Échantillons :\n")

  cat(paste(echantillons, collapse = "\n"), "\n")
} else {
  cat("  Aucune donnée unique au jeu de feuilles\n")
}
cat("\n")

# === 4. PARCELLES LES PLUS REPRÉSENTÉES ===
cat("📍 PARCELLES LES PLUS REPRÉSENTÉES\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════\n\n")

afficher_top_parcelles <- function(parcelles_info, nom) {
  cat(paste0("▶ ", nom, " :\n"))
  if (nrow(parcelles_info$parcelles_les_plus_frequentes) > 0) {
    for (i in 1:nrow(parcelles_info$parcelles_les_plus_frequentes)) {
      parcelle <- parcelles_info$parcelles_les_plus_frequentes[i, ]
      cat("  ", i, ". ", parcelle$Parcelle, " (", parcelle$n, " observations)\n")
    }
  } else {
    cat("  Aucune donnée disponible\n")
  }
  cat("\n")
}

afficher_top_parcelles(parcelles_rendement, "RENDEMENT")
afficher_top_parcelles(parcelles_sol, "SOL")
afficher_top_parcelles(parcelles_feuille, "FEUILLES")

# === 5. RÉSUMÉ GLOBAL ===
cat("📋 RÉSUMÉ GLOBAL\n")
cat("═════════════════\n\n")

total_observations <- nrow(yield_keys) + nrow(soil_keys) + nrow(leaf_keys)
total_unique <- nrow(unique_rendement) + nrow(unique_sol) + nrow(unique_feuille)
taux_correspondance_complete <- round(nrow(correspondance_complete) / total_observations * 100, 2)
taux_donnees_uniques <- round(total_unique / total_observations * 100, 2)

# Période globale
all_years <- c(yield_keys$Annee, soil_keys$Annee, leaf_keys$Annee)
periode_globale_min <- min(all_years, na.rm = TRUE)
periode_globale_max <- max(all_years, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("• Période d'étude globale :", periode_globale_min, "-", periode_globale_max, 
    "(", periode_globale_max - periode_globale_min + 1, "années)\n")
cat("• Total des observations :", format(total_observations, big.mark = " "), "couples parcelle-année\n")
cat("• Correspondance complète :", format(nrow(correspondance_complete), big.mark = " "), 
    "couples (", round(nrow(correspondance_complete) / total_observations * 100, 1), "% du total)\n")
cat("• Données uniques :", format(total_unique, big.mark = " "), 
    "couples (", taux_donnees_uniques, "% du total)\n")

# Efficacité de la correspondance
efficacite_max_possible <- min(nrow(yield_keys), nrow(soil_keys), nrow(leaf_keys))
efficacite_reelle <- round(nrow(correspondance_complete) / efficacite_max_possible * 100, 1)
cat("• Efficacité de correspondance :", efficacite_reelle, "% (vs maximum théorique possible)\n\n")
```

```{r}
# ===============================
# 1. TREND EVOLUTION WITH SE + LOESS - COMBINED PLOT
# ===============================

create_combined_trends <- function(data) {
  
  # Prepare data for trends
  trend_data <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(Year) & !is.na(Tc_Ha_A) & !is.na(T_pol_canne)) %>%
    group_by(Year) %>%
    summarise(
      Tc_mean = mean(Tc_Ha_A, na.rm = TRUE),
      Tc_se = sd(Tc_Ha_A, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
      Tc_sd = sd(Tc_Ha_A, na.rm = TRUE),
      Pol_mean = mean(T_pol_canne, na.rm = TRUE),
      Pol_se = sd(T_pol_canne, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
      Pol_sd = sd(T_pol_canne, na.rm = TRUE),
      n = n(),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )
  
  # Create dual-axis plot
  p1 <- ggplot(trend_data, aes(x = Year)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = Tc_mean), color = "#e74c3c", size = 1.5, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_point(aes(y = Tc_mean), color = "#e74c3c", size = 4, alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Tc_mean - Tc_se, ymax = Tc_mean + Tc_se), 
                  color = "#e74c3c", width = 0.2, size = 1, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_smooth(aes(y = Tc_mean), method = "loess", se = TRUE, 
                color = "#c0392b", fill = "#e74c3c", alpha = 0.3, span = 0.8) +
    labs(title = "Sugarcane Yield Evolution - Senegal Sahel Region",
         subtitle = "Tc/Ha with Standard Error bars and LOESS smoothing",
         x = "Year", 
         y = "Tc/Ha (Tons per Hectare)",
         caption = "Error bars represent ±1 SE") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 6)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = comma_format()) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray60"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    )
  
  p2 <- ggplot(trend_data, aes(x = Year)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = Pol_mean), color = "#3498db", size = 1.5, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_point(aes(y = Pol_mean), color = "#3498db", size = 4, alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Pol_mean - Pol_se, ymax = Pol_mean + Pol_se), 
                  color = "#3498db", width = 0.2, size = 1, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_smooth(aes(y = Pol_mean), method = "loess", se = TRUE, 
                color = "#2980b9", fill = "#3498db", alpha = 0.3, span = 0.8) +
    labs(title = "Sugar Content (Pol) Evolution",
         subtitle = "T_pol/canne with Standard Error bars and LOESS smoothing",
         x = "Year", 
         y = "T_pol/canne (Pol tons per cane)",
         caption = "Error bars represent ±1 SE") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 6)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = comma_format()) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray60"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    )
  
  return(list(tc_plot = p1, pol_plot = p2, trend_data = trend_data))
}

trend_results <- create_combined_trends(leaf_data_converted)

# ===============================
# 2. COMBINED DUAL-AXIS PLOT
# ===============================
create_dual_axis_plot <- function(data) {
  
  trend_data <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(Year) & !is.na(Tc_Ha_A) & !is.na(T_pol_canne)) %>%
    group_by(Year) %>%
    summarise(
      Tc_mean = mean(Tc_Ha_A, na.rm = TRUE),
      Tc_se = sd(Tc_Ha_A, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
      Pol_mean = mean(T_pol_canne, na.rm = TRUE),
      Pol_se = sd(T_pol_canne, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )
  
  # Scale factor for dual axis
  scale_factor <- max(trend_data$Tc_mean, na.rm = TRUE) / max(trend_data$Pol_mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  p_dual <- ggplot(trend_data, aes(x = Year)) +
    # Primary axis (Tc/Ha_A)
    geom_line(aes(y = Tc_mean, color = "Tc/Ha"), size = 1.5) +
    geom_point(aes(y = Tc_mean, color = "Tc/Ha"), size = 4) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Tc_mean - Tc_se, ymax = Tc_mean + Tc_se, color = "Tc/Ha"), 
                  width = 0.2, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_smooth(aes(y = Tc_mean), method = "loess", se = TRUE, 
                color = "#e74c3c", fill = "#e74c3c", alpha = 0.2) +
    
    # Secondary axis (T_pol_canne scaled)
    geom_line(aes(y = Pol_mean * scale_factor, color = "T_pol/canne"), size = 1.5) +
    geom_point(aes(y = Pol_mean * scale_factor, color = "T_pol/canne"), size = 4) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = (Pol_mean - Pol_se) * scale_factor, 
                     ymax = (Pol_mean + Pol_se) * scale_factor, color = "T_pol/canne"), 
                  width = 0.2, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_smooth(aes(y = Pol_mean * scale_factor), method = "loess", se = TRUE, 
                color = "#3498db", fill = "#3498db", alpha = 0.2) +
    
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Tc/Ha" = "#e74c3c", "T_pol/canne" = "#3498db")) +
    
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = "Tc/Ha (Tons per Hectare)",
      sec.axis = sec_axis(~./scale_factor, name = "T_pol/canne (Pol tons)")
    ) +
    
    labs(title = "Combined Sugarcane Yield Evolution",
         subtitle = "Tc/Ha and T_pol/canne trends with LOESS smoothing and SE bars",
         x = "Year",
         color = "Parameter",
         caption = "Dual-axis plot with independent LOESS trends") +
    
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title.y = element_text(color = "#e74c3c", face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "#3498db", face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  
  return(p_dual)
}

dual_plot <- create_dual_axis_plot(leaf_data_converted)
print(dual_plot)

# ===============================
# 3. BOXPLOTS BY YEAR AND VARIETY
# ===============================

create_comprehensive_boxplots <- function(data) {
  
  clean_data <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(Year) & !is.na(Tc_Ha_A) & !is.na(T_pol_canne) & !is.na(Variete))
  
  # Tc/Ha_A boxplots by year
  p1 <- ggplot(clean_data, aes(x = factor(Year), y = Tc_Ha_A)) +
    geom_violin(alpha = 0.6, fill = "#e74c3c") +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.3, alpha = 0.8, outlier.color = "#c0392b") +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3, color = "white", shape = 21, fill = "red") +
    labs(title = "Tc/Ha Distribution by Year",
         subtitle = "Violin plots with boxplots and mean points",
         x = "Year", y = "Tc/Ha (Tons per Hectare)") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  
  # T_pol_canne boxplots by year
  p2 <- ggplot(clean_data, aes(x = factor(Year), y = T_pol_canne)) +
    geom_violin(alpha = 0.6, fill = "#3498db") +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.3, alpha = 0.8, outlier.color = "#2980b9") +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3, color = "white", shape = 21, fill = "blue") +
    labs(title = "T_pol/canne Distribution by Year",
         subtitle = "Violin plots with boxplots and mean points", 
         x = "Year", y = "T_pol/canne (Pol tons)") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  
  # Variety comparison
  p3 <- ggplot(clean_data, aes(x = Variete, y = Tc_Ha_A, fill = Variete)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, outlier.alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.4, size = 1) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3, color = "red", shape = 18) +
    facet_wrap(~Year, scales = "free_x") +
    scale_fill_viridis_d() +
    labs(title = "Tc/Ha by Variety Across Years",
         x = "Variety", y = "Tc/Ha (Tons per Hectare)") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          legend.position = "none")
  
  # Sugar efficiency comparison
  p4 <- ggplot(clean_data, aes(x = Variete, y = Sugar_efficiency, fill = Variete)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, outlier.alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.4, size = 1) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3, color = "red", shape = 18) +
    facet_wrap(~Year, scales = "free_x") +
    scale_fill_viridis_d() +
    labs(title = "Sugar Efficiency by Variety Across Years",
         x = "Variety", y = "Sugar Efficiency (%)") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          legend.position = "none")
  
  return(list(tc_year = p1, pol_year = p2, tc_variety = p3, sugar_variety = p4))
}
```

```{r}
# ===============================
# SUGARCANE NPK ANALYSIS 
# Visualization and Trend Analysis
# ===============================

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(corrplot)
library(pheatmap)
library(viridis)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(gridExtra)
library(scales)
library(broom)
library(GGally)
library(factoextra)
library(FactoMineR)



cat("SUGARCANE DATASET ANALYSIS - SENEGAL\n")
cat("====================================\n")
print(dim(leaf_data_converted))
print(head(leaf_data_converted, 3))

# ===============================
# 1. DATA PREPROCESSING
# ===============================

cat("Actual column names:\n")
print(names(leaf_data_converted))

original_names <- names(leaf_data_converted)

leaf_data_converted$N_pct <- as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", leaf_data_converted$N.))
leaf_data_converted$P_pct <- as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", leaf_data_converted$X.P))
leaf_data_converted$K_pct <- as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", leaf_data_converted$X.K))
leaf_data_converted$Tc_Ha_A_1 <- as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", leaf_data_converted$Tc.Ha_A.1))
leaf_data_converted$RH_pctC_A_1 <- as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", leaf_data_converted$RH.C_A.1))
leaf_data_converted$Tc_Ha_A <- as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", leaf_data_converted$Tc.Ha_A))
leaf_data_converted$RH_pctC_A <- as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", leaf_data_converted$RH.C_A))
leaf_data_converted$T_canne_reelle <- as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", leaf_data_converted$T_canne_reelle))
leaf_data_converted$T_pol_canne <- as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", leaf_data_converted$T_pol_canne))
leaf_data_converted$H2O_feuilles <- as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", leaf_data_converted$H2O_feuilles))
leaf_data_converted$H20_gaines <- as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", leaf_data_converted$H20_gaines))
leaf_data_converted$Age_prel_ <- as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", leaf_data_converted$Age_prel))

leaf_data_converted$Variete <- as.factor(leaf_data_converted$Variete)
leaf_data_converted$Ferme <- as.factor(leaf_data_converted$Ferme)
leaf_data_converted$Campagne <- as.factor(leaf_data_converted$Campagne)

leaf_data_converted$NPK_ratio <- leaf_data_converted$N_pct / (leaf_data_converted$P_pct + leaf_data_converted$K_pct)
leaf_data_converted$Sugar_efficiency <- leaf_data_converted$T_pol_canne / leaf_data_converted$T_canne_reelle * 100
leaf_data_converted$Biomass_index <- leaf_data_converted$T_canne_reelle / leaf_data_converted$Surf

# ===============================
# 2. NPK TREND ANALYSIS WITH LOESS AND CONFIDENCE INTERVALS
# ===============================

create_npk_trends <- function(data) {
  npk_long <- data %>%
    select(Age_prel_, N_pct, P_pct, K_pct, Variete, Campagne) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Age_prel_) & !is.na(N_pct) & !is.na(P_pct) & !is.na(K_pct)) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(N_pct, P_pct, K_pct), names_to = "Nutrient", values_to = "Concentration")

  p1 <- ggplot(npk_long, aes(x = Age_prel_, y = Concentration, color = Nutrient)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, span = 0.7, size = 1.2) +
    facet_wrap(~Nutrient, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("N_pct" = "#e74c3c", "P_pct" = "#3498db", "K_pct" = "#2ecc71")) +
    labs(title = "NPK Concentration Trends Over Plant Age",
         subtitle = "LOESS smoothing with 95% confidence intervals",
         x = "Plant Age (days)", y = "Nutrient Concentration (%)",
         caption = "Sugarcane - Senegal Sahel Region") +
    theme_minimal()
  return(p1)
}

npk_plot <- create_npk_trends(leaf_data_converted)
print(npk_plot)

# ===============================
# 3. NPK vs BIOMASS AND SUGAR CONTENT ANALYSIS
# ===============================

create_npk_biomass_plots <- function(data) {
  clean_data <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(N_pct) & !is.na(P_pct) & !is.na(K_pct) &
           !is.na(T_canne_reelle) & !is.na(T_pol_canne))

  clean_data$Sugar_efficiency <- clean_data$T_pol_canne / clean_data$T_canne_reelle * 100

  p1 <- ggplot(clean_data, aes(x = N_pct, y = T_canne_reelle)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = Variete), size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "darkred", size = 1.2)

  p2 <- ggplot(clean_data, aes(x = P_pct, y = T_pol_canne)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = Variete), size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "darkblue", size = 1.2)

  p3 <- ggplot(clean_data, aes(x = K_pct, y = Sugar_efficiency)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = Variete), size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "darkgreen", size = 1.2)

  clean_data$NP_ratio <- clean_data$N_pct / clean_data$P_pct
  p4 <- ggplot(clean_data, aes(x = NP_ratio, y = T_canne_reelle)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = Sugar_efficiency, size = T_pol_canne), alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, color = "purple", size = 1.2)

  return(list(p1, p2, p3, p4))
}

biomass_plots <- create_npk_biomass_plots(leaf_data_converted)
grid.arrange(grobs = biomass_plots, ncol = 2)
```

## IV.2. Data Type Identification and Conversion

```{r}
# ===============================
cat("2. DATA TYPE IDENTIFICATION AND CONVERSION\n")
cat("==========================================\n")

# Define data types based on domain knowledge
factor_variables <- c(
  "Campaign",                  # Campaign
  "Note",              # Note
  "Plot",                       # Plot
  "Farm",                       # Farm
  "Variety",                    # Variety
  "Crop_Cycle",                 # Cycle
  "Growth_Period",              # Period
  "Period_Validation",          # Period validation
  "Plot_Campaign",              # Campaign plot
  "Harvest_Validation",         # Harvest validation
  "Irrigation_Type",            # Irrigation type
  "Harvest_Month",              # Harvest month
  "Sampling_Month",
  "Week_Number",
  "Data_Day"
)

# Date variables
date_variables <- c(
  "Planting_date",             # Planting date
  "Sampling_date",                   # Sampling date
  "Analysis_Date",               # Analysis date
  "Harvest_Date",                # Harvest date
  "Common_Harvest_Date"          # Common harvest date
)

# Numerical variables
numerical_variables <- c(
  "Surface_ha",  
  "A_ce_jour",
  "Sampling_Age",                 
  "Yield_tonnes_ha_year_minus_1",               
  "Cane_Moisture_percent_year_minus_1",         
  "Leaf_Moisture_percent",               # Leaf water content
  "Sheath_Moisture_percent",             # Sheath water content
  "Nitrogen_percent",                    # Nitrogen %
  "Phosphorus_percent",                  # Phosphorus %
  "Potassium_percent",                   # Potassium %
  "Yield_tonnes_ha_year_actual",         # Actual cane yield
  "Cane_Moisture_percent_year_actual",           # Actual sugar content
  "Real_T_canne",   
  "T_Pol_canne",
  "Age_weeks",
  "Harvest_Age_year",                    # Age at harvest
  "Agricultural_Surface_ha",             # Surface area actual
  "Surface_Age_days"
)

# Check which variables actually exist in the dataset
existing_factors <- intersect(factor_variables, names(leaf_data))
existing_dates <- intersect(date_variables, names(leaf_data))
existing_numerics <- intersect(numerical_variables, names(leaf_data))

cat("FACTOR VARIABLES (", length(existing_factors), " found):\n")
print(existing_factors)
cat("\nDATE VARIABLES (", length(existing_dates), " found):\n")
print(existing_dates)
cat("\nNUMERICAL VARIABLES (", length(existing_numerics), " found):\n")
print(existing_numerics)

# Variables not classified
all_classified <- c(existing_factors, existing_dates, existing_numerics)
unclassified <- setdiff(names(leaf_data), all_classified)
if(length(unclassified) > 0) {
  cat("\nUNCLASSIFIED VARIABLES:\n")
  print(unclassified)
  
  cat("\nSUGGESTED CLASSIFICATION FOR UNCLASSIFIED VARIABLES:\n")
  for(var in unclassified) {
    sample_values <- head(unique(leaf_data[[var]][!is.na(leaf_data[[var]]) & leaf_data[[var]] != ""]), 5)
    cat("Variable:", var, "| Sample values:", paste(sample_values, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    
    non_empty <- leaf_data[[var]][!is.na(leaf_data[[var]]) & leaf_data[[var]] != ""]
    if(length(non_empty) > 0) {
      numeric_test <- gsub(",", ".", non_empty)
      if(all(str_detect(numeric_test, "^-?[0-9]*\\.?[0-9]+$|^$"), na.rm = TRUE)) {
        cat("  -> Suggested: NUMERIC\n")
      } else if(length(unique(non_empty)) < 20 && length(non_empty) > 10) {
        cat("  -> Suggested: FACTOR\n")
      } else {
        cat("  -> Suggested: CHARACTER/OTHER\n")
      }
    }
  }
}

# ===============================
# 3. CONVERT DATA TYPES
# ===============================
cat("\n3. DATA TYPE CONVERSION\n")
cat("=======================\n")

# Create a copy for conversion
leaf_data_converted <- leaf_data

# Convert factors
for(var in existing_factors) {
  if(var %in% names(leaf_data_converted)) {
    leaf_data_converted[[var]] <- as.factor(leaf_data_converted[[var]])
    cat("Converted", var, "to factor -", nlevels(leaf_data_converted[[var]]), "levels\n")
  }
}

# Convert dates
for(var in existing_dates) {
  if(var %in% names(leaf_data_converted)) {
    original_values <- leaf_data_converted[[var]]
    
    if(all(str_detect(original_values[!is.na(original_values) & original_values != ""], "^[0-9]+$"), na.rm = TRUE)) {
      leaf_data_converted[[var]] <- as.Date(as.numeric(original_values), origin = "1899-12-30")
      cat("Converted", var, "from Excel numeric format to Date\n")
    } else {
      date_converted <- as.Date(original_values, format = "%d/%m/%Y")
      if(all(is.na(date_converted))) {
        date_converted <- as.Date(original_values, format = "%Y-%m-%d")
      }
      if(all(is.na(date_converted))) {
        date_converted <- as.Date(original_values, format = "%m/%d/%Y")
      }
      leaf_data_converted[[var]] <- date_converted
      cat("Converted", var, "to Date format\n")
    }
    
    valid_dates <- leaf_data_converted[[var]][!is.na(leaf_data_converted[[var]])]
    if(length(valid_dates) > 0) {
      date_range <- range(valid_dates)
      cat("  Date range:", as.character(date_range[1]), "to", as.character(date_range[2]), "\n")
    }
  }
}

# Convert numerics
for(var in existing_numerics) {
  if(var %in% names(leaf_data_converted)) {
    leaf_data_converted[[var]][leaf_data_converted[[var]] == "" | leaf_data_converted[[var]] == " "] <- NA
    if(is.character(leaf_data_converted[[var]])) {
      leaf_data_converted[[var]] <- gsub(",", ".", leaf_data_converted[[var]])
    }
    original_nas <- sum(is.na(leaf_data[[var]]))
    leaf_data_converted[[var]] <- as.numeric(leaf_data_converted[[var]])
    new_nas <- sum(is.na(leaf_data_converted[[var]]))
    conversion_nas <- new_nas - original_nas
    
    if(conversion_nas > 0) {
      cat("WARNING:", conversion_nas, "values became NA during conversion of", var, "\n")
      problematic <- leaf_data[[var]][is.na(leaf_data_converted[[var]]) & !is.na(leaf_data[[var]])]
      if(length(problematic) > 0) {
        cat("  Examples of unconverted values:", paste(head(problematic, 3), collapse = ", "), "\n")
      }
    } else {
      cat("Successfully converted", var, "to numeric\n")
    }
  }
}

str(leaf_data_converted)

```

```{r}
publication_theme <- theme_minimal() +

    panel.spacing = unit(0.4, "lines"),    # Tighter panel spacing
    axis.line = element_line(color = "#000000", size = 0.6)
  )

# Function to detect outliers using IQR method
detect_outliers <- function(x) {
  q1 <- quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
  q3 <- quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  iqr <- q3 - q1
  lower_bound <- q1 - 1.5 * iqr
  upper_bound <- q3 + 1.5 * iqr
  return(x < lower_bound | x > upper_bound)
}

# Enhanced function to create narrow boxplots with red outlier detection
create_enhanced_boxplot <- function(data_long, title, subtitle, colors, x_label, y_label, 
                                  variable_col = "variable", value_col = "value", remove_outliers = FALSE) {
  
  # Detect outliers for each variable
  data_with_outliers <- data_long %>%
    group_by(!!sym(variable_col)) %>%
    mutate(
      is_outlier = detect_outliers(!!sym(value_col)),
      outlier_label = ifelse(is_outlier, "Outlier", "Normal")
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # Remove outliers if requested
  if (remove_outliers) {
    plot_data <- data_with_outliers %>% filter(!is_outlier)
    title <- paste(title, "(Without Outliers)")
  } else {
    plot_data <- data_with_outliers
  }
  
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes_string(x = variable_col, y = value_col, fill = variable_col)) +
    geom_boxplot(
      alpha = 0.85, 
      outlier.shape = NA,  # Hide default outliers
      width = 0.18,  # EVEN TIGHTER boxplots
      color = "#000000",  # Clear black contour
      size = 0.6,  # Slightly thinner for tighter look
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    # Add red outlier points manually
    {if (!remove_outliers) {
      geom_point(
        data = plot_data %>% filter(is_outlier),
        aes_string(x = variable_col, y = value_col),
        color = "#DC143C",  # Bright red for outliers
        size = 1.2,  # Slightly smaller for tighter layout
        alpha = 0.8,
        shape = 16,
        inherit.aes = FALSE
      )
    }} +
    stat_summary(
      fun = median, 
      geom = "text", 
      aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", after_stat(y))),
      size = 2.5,  # Slightly smaller text for tighter layout
      color = "white", 
      fontface = "bold",
      vjust = 0.5
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x = x_label,
      y = y_label
    ) +
    publication_theme +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.01)) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off")
  
  return(p)
}
```
